limits: No release preparation or archive rebuild in this independent R4 check; prior full-archive fingerprint evidence remains the coverage basis.
source_bound_findings: Python and Node use exact plain X.Y.Z regex with no leading-zero numeric components or suffix acceptance.
Both gates require editionKey and modifiedAt as a pair; missing both is allowed for legacy 0.14.1 and rejected for >=0.15.0, including 1.x.
Both gates reject empty or padded edition keys and invalid UTC timestamps including impossible calendar dates.

Node release guard validates before reading or writing release snapshots; actual CLI tests show invalid records leave absent or existing snapshot bytes unchanged and valid legacy/new records rerun stably.
EPUB builder and checker hashes are unchanged from prior accepted full-payload fingerprint review.
